samples.xml_description:
<module id="asyn_fifo">
    <description>Asynchronous FIFO with configurable depth and width.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="wclk">Write clock signal used for synchronous write operations.</input>
        <input id="rclk">Read clock signal used for synchronous read operations.</input>
        <input id="wrstn">Write reset signal. Defined as 0 for reset and 1 for reset signal inactive.</input>
        <input id="rrstn">Read reset signal. Defined as 0 for reset and 1 for reset signal inactive.</input>
        <input id="winc">Write increment signal. Used to trigger write operations.</input>
        <input id="rinc">Read increment signal. Used to trigger read operations.</input>
        <input id="wdata" width_description="[WIDTH-1:0]">Write data input.</input>
        <output id="wfull">Write full signal. Indicates if the FIFO is full and cannot accept further write operations.</output>
        <output id="rempty">Read empty signal. Indicates if the FIFO is empty and cannot provide any data for read operations.</output>
        <output id="rdata" width_description="[WIDTH-1:0]">Read data output.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="WIDTH" value="8">FIFO data width.</parameter>
        <parameter id="DEPTH" value="16">FIFO depth.</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description>
        <type="sequential_logic">reg</type>
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        // Define parameters
        parameter WIDTH = 8;
        parameter DEPTH = 16;

        // Define signals
        reg [WIDTH-1:0] RAM_MEM [0:DEPTH-1];
        reg [WIDTH-1:0] wdata_reg;
        reg [WIDTH-1:0] rdata_reg;
        reg [WIDTH-1:0] waddr_bin, raddr_bin;
        reg [WIDTH-1:0] wptr, rptr, wptr_syn, rptr_syn;
        reg [WIDTH-1:0] wptr_buff, rptr_buff;
        reg wfull_reg, rempty_reg;

        // Write pointer logic
        always @(posedge wclk or negedge wrstn) begin
            if (!wrstn) begin
                waddr_bin <= 0;
                wptr <= 0;
            end else if (winc && !wfull_reg) begin
                waddr_bin <= waddr_bin + 1;
                wptr <= waddr_bin;
            end
        end

        // Read pointer logic
        always @(posedge rclk or negedge rrstn) begin
            if (!rrstn) begin
                raddr_bin <= 0;
                rptr <= 0;
            end else if (rinc && !rempty_reg) begin
                raddr_bin <= raddr_bin + 1;
                rptr <= raddr_bin;
            end
        end

        // Gray code conversion
        always @(posedge wclk or negedge wrstn or posedge rclk or negedge rrstn) begin
            if (!wrstn || !rrstn) begin
                wptr_buff <= 0;
                rptr_buff <= 0;
            end else begin
                wptr_buff <= wptr;
                rptr_buff <= rptr;
            end
        end

        always @(posedge wclk or posedge rclk) begin
            wptr_syn <= wptr_buff;
            rptr_syn <= rptr_buff;
        end

        // Full and empty signals
        always @(*) begin
            wfull_reg = (wptr_syn == {~rptr_syn[WIDTH-1], rptr_syn[WIDTH-2:0]});
            rempty_reg = (wptr_syn == rptr_syn);
        end

        // RAM memory
        always @(posedge wclk) begin
            if (winc && !wfull_reg) begin
                RAM_MEM[waddr_bin] <= wdata;
            end
        end

        // Data output
        always @(posedge rclk) begin
            if (!rempty_reg) begin
                rdata_reg <= RAM_MEM[raddr_bin];
            end
        end

        // Assign outputs
        assign wfull = wfull_reg;
        assign rempty = rempty_reg;
        assign rdata = rdata_reg;
    </implementation>
</module>
